onset.agreement: Delivered transcript only; responsive commitments from both participants or proposed alternative acceptance rule explicitly adopted by other; reject agreement and unrelated statements do not qualify
onset.labels: EX if current agreement; else RR if previous mixed correct-accept/wrong-reject and rejecting agent relaxed then accepts; else SR if previous both wrong-reject and both relaxed then accept; else Other
